title: Solo dev, nearly done: you build a medieval Bohemian city, then live in it as its king
author: Crafty_Ad_2917
selftext:
Hi, I’m the solo dev. The game is set in 14th/15th-century Bohemia and rests on three things: building the city (construction is physical, crews raise each building piece by piece), living in it (you walk the streets as the king, in third person), and playing a real RPG on top of that. A story campaign is planned after Early Access; the launch version is a sandbox. I’m in the final stretch and would love to hear what you’d expect from a game like this.

[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5385320/Wolfsbanner\_Medieval\_Kingdom\_RPG/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5385320/Wolfsbanner_Medieval_Kingdom_RPG/)
